texts.preamble: M/S Sodexo Food Solution India Pvt. Ltd. vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2019 Bench: Shashi Kant Gupta, Shamim Ahmed High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Court No. - 32 Case :- Writ - C No. - 41557 of 2019 Petitioner :- M/S Sodexo Food Solution India Pvt. Ltd. Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others Counsel for Petitioner :- Ashish Goyal
texts.arguments: Against the said order, petitioner-company as well as its Director/Manager Mr. R. Prasanna Venkatesh preferred an appeal under Section 70 of the Act wherein Tribunal stayed the recovery against the petitioner-company and its Director/Manager Mr. R. Prasanna Venkatesh in case theydeposit 50% of the penalty imposed by the Respondent No. 3 against both of them, meaning thereby the petitioner-company as well as its Director/Manager Mr. R. Prasanna Venkatesh were directed to deposit 50% only (i.e. Rs. 1,50,000/- each totalling Rs. 3,00,000/-) out of Rs. 6,00,000/- (rupees six lacs). According to learned counsel for the petitioner, the petitioner-company and its Director/Manager Mr. R. Prasanna Venkatesh have already deposited half of the fine amount i.e. Rs. 1,50,000/- each totalling Rs. 3,00,000/- in pursuance of the order dated 6.8.2015 passed by the Tribunal but still recovery citation has been issued against the petitioner instead of M/s Krishna Trading Corporation, Delhi, which did not prefer any appeal against the order dated 30.6.2015 passed by the Respondent No. 3. He further submitted that since the petitioner-company and its Director/Manager Mr. R. Prasanna Venkatesh have already deposited half of the penalty amount imposed upon them and the recovery for the balance amount is stayed, no fresh recovery citation or recovery certificate can be issued by the Respondent No. 3 against the petitioner-company and its Director/Manager Mr. R. Prasanna Venkatesh during the pendency of the appeal.
